rejected_experiments: None beyond the single evidence-guided pass; two real bugs were caught and fixed before scoring rather than left in: the result[2] clamp direction was initially inverted (assembly's `cmp r2,#249; bgt .L9` skips the clamp-to-250 only when r2>249, i.e. it is a *minimum* clamp on the low side, not the maximum clamp the mirror-image code in this family might suggest at a glance), and an overcomplicated, incorrect derivation of the table-lookup source offset was simplified to the direct form `(j & 3) * 770 + Data_080ede48[raw - 1]` by re-deriving the register algebra by hand instead of trusting the first pass through it.

Semantic summary: a single-target (not per-member-list) battle-presentation sub-effect. Seeds a 256-slot particle pool at 0x02010000 with random signed positions and zeroed velocity/lifetime fields, sets up one fixed 3-word draw record (0,160<<15,0), then runs 160 animation passes. Each pass re-establishes the facing/portrait draw, then walks the first 64 pool slots: once a slot's activation threshold (a function of its index divided by 4) is crossed and it is still marked inactive, it fires one of four velocity-kick calls selected by (index & 3), transforms it through Func_080e3944, clamps and buckets the transformed distance into a lookup-table draw offset, and draws it via Func_080072f4; independently, once a slightly later threshold is crossed, the slot's position is decayed by a shifted, negated velocity term every pass (simple drag).

Two open questions carried over from the earlier owners in this family and not re-litigated here for time: the observed 5th-argument-in-r4 calling convention at the Func_080072f4 site, and this compiler's register choice for the shared work pointer (kept in fp here, matching the reference this time, unlike 080d59b0 where fp/r9 diverged) -- worth revisiting once the family gets a shared header.
No GS2 or external source was used; no other Golden Sun decompilation project was consulted.
